weeks.bio: DJ Shakti Rising, aka Sitara, born & raised in NE Portland, Oregon, birthed and produced the wonderful Unity Ecstatic Dance Ashland for 4.5 years, an amazing era of next generation Ecstatic Dance in Ashland OR. Sitara has been a dancer since she can remember & has been devoted to music and dance for the last 35+ years. She has been in the worldwide network of Ecstatic Dance for over 18 years, a foundational practice for her self care, channeling energy in a healthy way, personal growth, transformations, joy and building community.
weeks.name: Dj Shakti Rising
weeks.somaticBlurb:
BodyHeart Enchantress Carolyn Candela leads the SomaLab this week.
Her caring, loving dance-altar craftations have been deepening our vessel’s spirit and now we get to experience her yogaTeach.

Heart Opening Yoga & Intuitive Dance

“Soften your body. Open your heart. Let yourself move.

In this gentle, nourishing movement journey, we’ll explore the connection between the heart and body through slow, melty yoga, conscious breath, and intuitive movement.

Beginning with grounding and heart-opening postures, we’ll invite the body to release its armor and soften into sensation. From this place of openness, we’ll transition into an intuitive dance exploration, allowing movement to arise organically rather than from the thinking mind.

Let this be an invitation to surrender, feel, play, and let your heart lead the way.”
-Carolyn

Our weekly eDance offers a facilitated movement experience called Soma Lab.
It’s included in the regular cost of entry.
Each Week:
7-7:45pm Soma Lab
8-10pm Ecstatic Dance
All together $22-18 Sliding Scale Payment

BendEcstaticDance.com

weeks.shortDescription: Amari is pure fire and sweet water swaddling in exalted steam mode. She's made many top quality and well loved sets for Bend Ecstatic Dance and is one of our most dedicated and consistent dancers. Her intuition and guidance for creating the sound journey is one of the finest treats to find yourself in the room with
weeks.name: SetList by Amari
weeks.setDescription: Bend Ecstatic Dance is one of the few edances of our size to continue to honor the art of setList making. SetList nights are not dj nights. This is an experience where the music journey is crafted ahead of time and the curator shares the dance floor with us. We adore these creations as part of our offering because setLists are artistic labors of love where the adventure has been thoroughly mapped out with great intention to detail and subtlety. We believe that this is a very important aspect of maintaining a dance that is focusing on the deep therapeutic value of diving deep into explorative realms of body/music exploration. These nights will often feature tracks from a much wider array of world music and offer transitions into emotive realms and tempo realms that seem unordinary to most dj sets. Amari is one of our favorite curators of this style.
weeks.somaticBlurb: Contact improvisation offers infinite possibilities, and yet we easily get locked into the few things we know. Slowing down, we will draw out the creativity of the moment so that we can feel the wholeness of our bodies present with others.

weeks.shortDescription:
Brian aka Medicine Music is the founder and resident DJ of OM
Garden, a monthly sacred dance event, and served as co-facilitator for Mount Shasta's Ecstatic Dance for many years. He travels globally, sharing his signature sound alongside visionary artists, musicians, and producers. Brian describes his music as a journey through mystical, ambient, tribal, and psychedelic spaces.
His sets move from deep, organic tribal house to global sounds spanning Meso-American Medicine Music, World Music, ie: African, Latin, Eastern Indian & Brazilian, Electronic Bass Music, Reggae, Drum N Bass, Dubstep, Hip Hop, and
sacred frequencies—all intended to uplift, heal, and expand consciousness. "I see all of it as healing medicine music".
weeks.bio:
A pioneering force in the San Francisco house and electronic music realm. As one of the founders of the legendary Remedy SF events, he produced transformational experiences for over two decades, DJing for 15 years and bringing some of the world's most respected artists to the stage.
Brian's journey began in 1990, during the rise of rave culture, when the rhythms of electronic music became a form of soul awakening. The foundational values of the movement, Peace, Love, Unity, and Respect resonated deeply, inspiring him to dedicate his life to music, community, and creating spaces that uplift consciousness.
Over time, the call to step behind the decks and craft his own music became undeniable, and Medicine Music was born. Following a period of personal transformation and spiritual awakening, Brian relocated to mystical Mount Shasta, known as the root chakra of the planet, to explore the healing power of music and dance in deeper ways. This path led him into the heart of conscious music festivals, ecstatic dance, and spiritually-driven sound experiences.
weeks.name: Dj Medicine Music
